headline: Godcrofts Goes Colonial as Hot Fronts Grind On
war_summary: Three hours past the midnight edition the map shows Godcrofts now listed nine Colonial to none after 28 changes in the day and nine in the last two hours about The Axehead and Fleecewatch, Linn Mercy now ten Colonial with one ruined and none Warden after 21 daily changes, and Stlican Shelf now six Warden to three Colonial after 58 daily changes and eight in the last two hours about Breaker Town and The Pale House. Fisherman's Row stands three Warden to six Colonial after 18 daily changes and three in the last two hours about Arcadia and Eidolo, while Callahan's Passage, nine Warden with one ruined, reports renewed action with two changes in two hours at The Latch after a quiet spell. Weathered Expanse remains six to three but is lively again with three changes in two hours and 57 in the day about Wightwalk and Frostmarch amid the heaviest day losses at 9,735 Colonial to 11,467 Warden. Stonecradle holds three to six with no change in the last two hours, and Farranac Coast, Viper Pit and Marban Hollow show no changes in six hours.
